Construction of Mahadev-Tolloi-
Pfutsero Road
441. SHRI RISHANG KEISHING:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) in which year construction of
Mahadev-Tolloi-Pfutsero Road (Manipur-
Nagaland) was proposed and included in
Work Programme;
(b) by when the construction of the road
will actually be taken up;
(c) the causes for the delay in taking up
the work, so far; and
(d) the agency which will execute the
work?
Status of PM’s commitment
442. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA :
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the status of the Prime Minister's
commitment as per the Shillong declaration
of January, 2000;
(b) the steps taken by Government to
ensure funds availability to meet the
disbursement targets set for NEDF and
benefits derived so far from the
disbursement;
(c) the status of RIDF targets set for
NABARD in the declaration and the
achievements; and
(d) the reasons for any shortfall and the
steps taken to meet the commitments?
Sale of I.T.D.C. Hotel at Kovalam
443. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) how far the efforts to sell the I.T.D.C.
Hotel at Kovalam have progressed;
(b) the area under possession of the
I.T.D.C. Hotel at Kovalam;
(c) the reserve price fixed;
(d) whether the valuation of the Hotel
was determined on the basis of the market
price or calculated under the discounted cash
flow method; and
(e) whether Government would order
for calculation on the basis of the market
price?

WIN2\SESSION\2028RS 102
Sale of ITDC Hotels
444. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has accepted
the bids for sale of four hotels of the India
Tourism Development Corporation;
(b) if so, the total amount received
through the sale of these four ITDC hotels;
(c) whether these four hotels have
suffered a combined loss of Rs. 11 crores
during the year 2001-2002; and
(d) the steps being taken to sell other
ITDC hotels in future?
Progress of disinvestment in PSUs
†445. SHRI P. K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the Public Sector
Undertakings in which Government have
decided to go in for disinvestment;
(b) the names of the undertakings in
which the process of disinvestment started
during the last three years and the position
of these undertakings at present;
(c) the names of the undertakings in
which disinvestment is planned during
current financial year and the progress of
disinvestment in each undertaking;
(d) whether Government propose to give
priority to those undertakings for
disinvestment which are loss-making; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Disinvestment of NALCO
446. DR. AKHILESH DAS: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether despite a request from the
Government of Orissa, Government have
decided to sell 30 per cent of shares of the
National Aluminium Company;
(b) if so, the details of State
Government's request and objections and
the reasons for overlooking the same; and
(c) the progress made, so far, in
disinvestment thereof alongwith the norms
adopted in arriving at the decision to
disinvestment and the extent thereof?
Amendment in Companies Act, 1956
447. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that schedules in
the Companies Act, 1956 have been
amended for facilitating disinvestment in
sectors such as coal, minerals, petroleum
products and petro chemicals;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the progress made in the dis-
investment process in these fields;
(d) the proposals in hand for dis-
investment in these fields; and
(e) the time by which the processes
would be completed?
Growth of unemployment due to
disinvestment policy
448. SHRI N. K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the disinvestment policy of
Government has resulted in growth of
unemployment;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have taken any
precautionary measures to deal with the
situation of unemployment in the light of
disinvestment policy; and
